CustomField.label: Passed Checks
CustomField.description: Controls how checks that Pass appear. "Show each check" lists every passed check. "Show count only" removes passed checks from the list; their count still appears in the summary bar at the bottom of the card. Defaults to "Show each check".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How passing checks appear. "Show each check" (default) = list them all. "Show count only" = hide from the list; the count still shows in the summary bar.
